proofPoints.title: Exact-card identity first
proofPoints.copy: FlipForge resolves the card, variation, grade, parallel, and listing context before evidence is allowed to influence the decision.

proofPoints.title: Evidence stays inspectable
proofPoints.copy: Accepted, excluded, conflicting, and missing evidence can remain visible instead of disappearing behind a single score.

proofPoints.title: Every decision keeps a receipt
proofPoints.copy: The decision can preserve what was known at T0, why records counted or did not count, and what action was supported.

proofPoints.title: Outcomes add context without rewriting history
proofPoints.copy: T7, T14, and T30 reviews add governed observations while T0 remains immutable.

proofPoints.title: Uncertainty can stop the decision
proofPoints.copy: When evidence is missing or weak, FlipForge can return VERIFY or PASS instead of inventing confidence.

claimPolicy: Only product behavior that is actually implemented and governed may be promoted as a proof point. Study accuracy percentages require separate authorization.
